cachePolicy: Reload saved results and task status; invalidate preview and replacement capabilities and renewed output-review consent
scientificMutation: A checkpoint never applies preparation, creates a scientific revision or freezes an output

storage.reclaimPolicy: After durable ACK only, preserve current/previous/all retained recovery references. Before ACK, a bounded capture reserve may be used only with verified snapshots and enough proven reclaimable bytes to return below the steady ceiling. Unknown/corrupt recovery blocks cleanup and reserve.

recovery.revisionConflict: Keep the draft and require explicit use of the saved state
recovery.missingProject: Open home and retain the checkpoint
recovery.corruption: Retain original bytes and show a warning
recovery.stagedSource: Verify hash and reconstruct File objects before mounting import hooks

failurePolicy: Keep editor and services before page destruction on unknown activity or an unacknowledged checkpoint. After committed destruction, abnormal service shutdown retains the durable checkpoint and reports failure instead of suspended; see shutdown-v1.json
reopenPolicy: Cancel a pending pause; after page destruction, finish owned shutdown and resume once
credentials: Current-user DPAPI, loopback listener ownership, PID creation identity, profile identity and a new launch key for each service cycle
